description: Phase A of prds/mailing-list-and-event-sponsorship-plan.md (Doug's rulings 2026-10-07). One many-to-many link so MANY partners can be associated with one event, mirroring the funder link CEvent.sponsorProfiles <-> CSponsorProfile.sponsoredEvents (relation cSponsorProfileEvent, read from crm-test 2026-10-07); plus the notice-campaign identifier on the event and on the registration. ADDITIVE ONLY: removing the old single partnerHost link is a hand step in cevent-partner-sponsorship-crm-handoff.md section 5, done AFTER this plan has been applied and the one crm-test value carried across.
